project_title: DealLoot - Heavy Discount, SuperCoin & Telegram Bot Auto-Publisher

tech_stack.frontend: React JS (.js / .jsx), Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, Lucide React Icons, Shadcn UI primitives, Sonner toasts
tech_stack.backend: FastAPI (Python) with Telegram Bot API integration, Sankmo Link Converter Engine, RSS/Telegram Channel Scraper, Deal History tracking

public_deals_site.header: Fixed z-50 glassmorphism navbar (bg-slate-950/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-slate-800) with Live Telemetry Ticker, Search bar, Category Filters, Mode Toggle, and 'Admin Control' quick link
public_deals_site.hero_banner: Asymmetric bento section highlighting '100% SuperCoin Drops', 'Flash Price Errors', live Telegram channel stats, and Sankmo auto-link status
public_deals_site.filter_bar: Sticky category pills (All Deals, Flipkart 100% SuperCoins, Gift Cards, 70%+ Off, Price Errors, Myntra/Amazon) with Sorting (Discount %, Price Low-High, Latest)
public_deals_site.deal_grid: Grid layout (grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4 gap-6) of interactive Deal Cards

deal_card.structure: Product thumbnail, Store logo badge (Flipkart, Amazon, Paytm, Myntra), Discount % Pill, Category Badge, Title, Old MRP vs Drop Price, Price Graph sparkline, Direct Buy/Grab Deal button (Sankmo transformed affiliate link), Copy Link button, Share to Telegram button

admin_dashboard.layout: Sidebar / Top Tabbed Control Panel with 6 main operational tabs:

tabs.name: Sources
tabs.description: Manage incoming sources (Public Telegram Channels, RSS Feeds, Twitter/X scrapers). Ability to add channel username (@deal_channel), test fetch, enable/disable auto-scraping toggle

tabs.name: Destinations
tabs.description: Configure outgoing Telegram Bots and Channels. Set Bot Token, Chat ID, custom channel rules (min discount %, filter categories: only SuperCoin, only GiftCards)

tabs.name: Rules & Filter Engine
tabs.description: Global auto-posting thresholds (e.g., Minimum Gift Card discount 15%, SuperCoin 100% auto-broadcast, Price Error auto-ping)

tabs.name: Manual Deal Add
tabs.description: Instant deal poster with URL input, auto-scraper metadata preview, custom title, price, MRP, category tag, and 'Post to Telegram & Web' trigger

tabs.name: Sankmo API & Converter
tabs.description: Sankmo Affiliate API key/token configuration, API endpoint URL, test URL converter input box, link transformation log

tabs.name: Post Logs & Telemetry
tabs.description: Live dispatch log showing deal ID, destination channel, converted affiliate URL, Telegram response status, timestamp

key_features_to_implement: Full Public Deal Feed with real-time category filtering (SuperCoin 100%, Gift Cards, Heavy Discount, Price Drop)
Search functionality for deals by store name or title
Sankmo Link Converter Engine: Automatically converts direct e-commerce URLs (Flipkart/Amazon) into affiliate earning links before posting
Telegram Bot Engine: Post deals directly to connected Telegram channels with customized message templates
Multi-Source Channel Auto-Fetch Simulator/Scraper: Add public Telegram channel handles to monitor & automatically extract deals
Multi-Destination Router: Route SuperCoin deals to specific Telegram channels and Gift Cards to others based on threshold rules
Manual Deal Posting Form with automatic metadata preview (Title, Price, Discount calculation)
Post Log audit trail showing status (Success/Failed), destination, timestamp, and converted Sankmo URL
instructions_to_main_agent: Build a complete, fully operational React frontend using `.js` / `.jsx` files and a FastAPI backend.
Ensure ALL files created use JavaScript syntax (.js/.jsx) - do NOT create TypeScript (.ts/.tsx) files.
Implement comprehensive seed data for deals: Flipkart 100% SuperCoin offers, Amazon price drop bugs, Swiggy/Zomato/Paytm gift card 20% cashback drops, Myntra flash sales.
Integrate Sankmo API URL transformer utility with fallback mock URL generator (e.g. converting `flipkart.com/item...` to `sankmo.com/redirect?url=...&affid=...`)
Ensure dropdowns, dialogs, and overlays NEVER have transparent backgrounds (use solid bg-slate-900 or bg-slate-950 with border-slate-800).
Ensure all buttons, tabs, inputs, and links have explicit hover/active states with contrasting text colors.
Provide toast notifications via `sonner` when deals are copied, manually added, sources updated, or Sankmo tokens saved.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.rule_1: Do not create TypeScript (.ts/.tsx) files. The codebase relies on .js and .jsx files.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.rule_2: Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes matching kebab-case naming.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.rule_3: Do not use transparent background on dropdowns, modals, or popovers. Always set bg-slate-900 / bg-slate-950.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.rule_4: Never use pure #000000; use rich dark tones like #0A0E17, #111827, and #161F30 for surfaces.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.rule_5: Keep all currency amounts formatted in Indian Rupees (₹) with proper comma separators.
